title: A Toxic Dilemma in the Alley — Part 2

cuts.voiceover_text: High above the neighborhood rooftops, the cat girl stands on her balcony exhaling thin clouds of smoke into the clear afternoon air.
Hours later, quiet calm turns into horror as she collapses across the tatami floor beside a strange, glowing rainbow puddle.
Feverish memories of a weeping elder rush through her mind, warning her of the destructive path she is following.
Vulnerability turns to terror when a dark gloved hand lunges directly at her face in the shadows. Does she have the strength to fight back, or has her luck finally run out?

series.summary: Afflicted by a bizarre glowing illness, the cat girl suffers feverish visions before being ambushed in the dark by a mysterious assailant.
